text:
Ana (Partnerships): FYI: LangChain + a systems integrator (Northstar SI) want a joint listing: LangChain connector + our Gateway + an orchestration quickstart. They want a simple onboarding doc and a sandbox run before we approve marketplace packaging. cc @Tom @Priya

Tom K.: happy to support. two questions: 1) do we treat the orchestration quickstart as a separate SKU or part of the bundle? 2) any special hardware requirements from the SI (they mentioned a tiny GPU cluster)?

Priya R.: from GTM side we'd prefer one bundle with optional add-ons. marketing wants a single promo asset. for the HW ask, can we surface recommended infra (e.g., 4xA10s for small pilot)?

Diego (Infra): infra note: for bundled offers we need a packaging manifest + tenant isolation. small change to our tenant mapper to tag marketplace bundles with `bundle_id`. ETA ~3d. regarding GPUs: we can recommend 2xA10 for demo, 4xA10 for production pilot.

Riley (Solutions): technical ask from LangChain: ensure our gateway exposes a simple orchestration webhook for their runner to call back on task completion. they'd like a signed callback (HMAC) and a sample implementation.

Ana (Partnerships): good. can we create a minimal integration checklist + quickstart script for their infra team? they want something they can run in ~30 minutes.

Tom K.: yes. rough steps: 1) provision staging tenant, 2) deploy gateway docker image with env vars, 3) configure orchestration webhook + HMAC secret, 4) register LangChain connector in staging. I'll draft a shell script and a docker-compose snippet.

Priya R.: timeline: partner wants a sandbox run next Thursday. Marketing needs assets by Tue. can we hit that?

Diego (Infra): if we start tomorrow, infra can have `bundle_id` tagging and a staging tenant ready in 72 hours.

Tom K.: here's a compact docker-compose sample for the quickstart we can share in the partner repo:

```
version: "3"
services:
  gateway:
    image: redwood/gateway:staging
    ports: ["8080:8080"]
    environment:
      - REDWOOD_TENANT=langchain-sandbox
      - BUNDLE_ID=langchain-gateway-bundle-2024
      - WEBHOOK_SECRET=replace_me
```

Tom K.: and a minimal curl to register the connector against staging gateway:

```
curl -X POST https://staging.redwood.ai/api/v1/connectors \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $REDWOOD_API_KEY" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"name":"langchain-connector","url":"https://lc.example.com/connector","webhook":"https://lc.example.com/webhook"}'
```

Riley (Solutions): for the HMAC callback we use sha256 with the webhook secret. sample node snippet I can paste into the quickstart.

Priya R.: can we include a permissions manifest for the marketplace listing? marketing needs to know which roles to display (admin/editor/viewer).

Diego (Infra): I'll produce a JSON template mapping connector roles to Redwood console roles and include it in the repo.

Ana (Partnerships): also note: Northstar SI requires a hardware compatibility note for their managed cluster. can someone draft recommended sizing + fallback for CPU-only?

Diego (Infra): recommend: demo = 2xA10 or 4xT4, pilot = 4xA10, fallback = 8xvCPUs + 32GB (very degraded perf). I'll add that to the quickstart.

Tom K.: I'll open a partner repo with an `/quickstart` folder and push the docker-compose, curl, node HMAC snippet, and a `smoke-test.sh` that runs basic round-trip checks.

ops-bot: ci-checker: partner-repo/quickstart smoke-test passed on staging at 2024-06-12T18:22:11Z.

Priya R.: perfect. Ana: i'll sync with marketing to draft the marketplace blurb and assets once Tom's PR is up.

Ana (Partnerships): thanks everyone. deliverables checklist: Tom -> quickstart PR (includes docker-compose, curl snippet, smoke-test), Diego -> permission-mapping.json + HW note, Riley -> HMAC node snippet, Priya -> marketing blurb draft. deadline: EOD Wed for PRs so we can run sandbox Thurs.

Riley (Solutions): noted, I'll add the HMAC snippet and a malformed-callback test to smoke-test so SI sees failure modes.

Tom K.: pinging when PR is ready.

marketing-bot: calendar: partner sandbox slot booked for 2024-06-20 10:00 PT.

Ana (Partnerships): great — I'll confirm with LangChain & Northstar SI and update the partner checklist. thanks all!
